summary_1line: Indra visits the Pandavas, blesses Yudhishthira, and Arjuna begins recounting his austerities and the encounter with the mysterious hunter after slaying a boar.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra, blazing with beauty, descends from a golden chariot amid Gandharvas and Apsaras while the Pandavas stand in reverence.
Arjuna with matted hair bows humbly before Indra as Yudhishthira joyfully smells the crown of his head.
In the forest, Arjuna and a fierce hunter simultaneously shoot a charging wild boar as it tears up the earth.
